$Comment: The Flaming Horseman's Breastplate, one of the five pieces the Horseman's Hoard can pay (ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase.json) and the stronger twin of the plain Horseman's Breastplate, whose model, texture and icon it shares. A member of the Hallowed set (ZiggfreedCommon/GearSets/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Hallowed.json) and of the Flaming Hallowed set (Hallows_Eve_Flaming_Hallowed.json). Its armour is the game's ancient steel breastplate's (the same Physical and Projectile resistance and Health), with its recipe left out (it is never crafted) and twice that piece's durability (150). On top of that it wards off Fire (DamageResistance.Fire, the Burning Jack Helm's shape, 0.10 is 10%) and raises DamageBonus_Fire, Ziggfreed's CommonLib's stat for Fire damage the wearer deals, in whole percent points, so a Lantern Bomb or any fire weapon hits 8% harder with it on. Light is the hotter glow of the Burning Jack Helm. An Armor block written here replaces a parent's whole, so the file restates every leaf rather than naming a parent. Tags.ZigLevel asks for Defense 30 to wear it (the best level the player ever reached), behind MMO Skill Tree's Gear levels switch (Tags.ZigLevelFeature); gear a player already had when gear levels arrived keeps working for them, and a server owner frees or retunes it with a ZigLevel group gate in mods/ziggfreedcommon/use-gates.json.
